versions.changelog: Require pitstop-cli 1.3.0 with download retries and MCP SDK 1.x/2.x support.
Complete flag lists, CLI to MCP name map, multi-fuel cheapest rule.

Corrects the previous upload, which contained an older installed skill snapshot. Publishes the skill from pitstop-cli v1.2.0: municipality disambiguation, coverage and cache freshness, exact fuel-row comparisons, public fast-CCS examples, and official tariff-page handoffs. Requires pitstop-cli>=1.2.0.

Requires pitstop-cli>=1.2.0. Adds municipality disambiguation, search coverage and cache freshness guidance, exact fuel-row comparisons and price ties, public fast-CCS examples, and official tariff-page handoffs.

- Updated minimum required version of pitstop-cli to 1.1.1 in installation metadata.
- Removed legacy file skill-card.md.

Corrects the outlier rule (percentage OR Tukey fence), documents that the outlier key is present only when true, adds the quality block and per-price median_basis, and replaces the claim that EV tariffs are not in open data with what pitstop actually parses. Requires pitstop-cli>=1.1.0.
Refresh install hints for pitstop-cli 1.0.2 and keep fuel plus EV charging guidance current.

Metadata-only: homepage URL updated to https://github.com/galjos/pitstop-cli (the GitHub repo was renamed to match the PyPI distribution name). Skill behavior, openclaw install hints, and content unchanged from 1.0.1.

Skill metadata fix only: corrected the PyPI install hint to point at the actual published distribution name 'pitstop-cli' (the bare 'pitstop' name was squatted on PyPI). The CLI binary, skill behavior, and all openclaw declarations are otherwise unchanged from 1.0.0.

First public release. Italian fuel prices (MIMIT) + EV charging (OSM Overpass) with operator tariff URLs. Multi-fuel queries, international comune names (Rome/Bozen/Mailand/...), GeoJSON output, navigation URLs, structured errors. Five MCP tools.
